<js>
html = "";
function get(datas, tag) {
	//解密方法由“尐哖”提供
	if (datas && datas['length'] > 0) {
		if ([2]['includes'](tag)) {
			var temp = [];
			for (var i of datas['reverse']()) {
				 temp['push'](i['reverse']());
			}
			datas = temp;
		}
		var conts = [];
		if ([3]['includes'](tag)){
			for (var j of datas) {
				var temp = []
				  , code = Math['ceil'](j['length'] / 2);
				for (let i = 0;i < code; i++) {
					temp['push'](j[i]);
					if ((i+code) < j['length']) {
						temp['push'](j[(i+ code)]);
					}
				}
				conts['push'](temp);
			}
		}
		else{
			for (var j of datas) {
				var temp = []
				  , code = Math['floor'](j['length'] / 2);
				for (let i = 0; i < code; i++) {
					temp['push'](j[i + code], j[i]);
				}
				if (j['length'] > (code*2)){temp['push'](j[j['length']-1]);}
				conts['push'](temp);
			}
		}
		return conts;
	}
}
